chunk.content: Rastrelliger mackerels, the genus sold as gembolo in West Sumatra, are marketed fresh, frozen, canned, dried-salted and smoked.
chunk.source_quote: The fish are marketed fresh, frozen, canned, dried salted and smoked.

source.title: FAO Species Catalogue Vol. 2. Scombrids of the World (Collette & Nauen 1983), section incl. Rastrelliger
